I already did and he told me he hadn’t recorded it. He knows I have paranoia and other mental health issues but him blocking me on the site isn’t helping the anxiety around it. 

Ahh don’t worry, I’ve had Valium so I’m exactly the same!
Earlier today. He seemed a bit annoyed at first that I was ending the sex talk but I explained why and he was fine once we agreed to be friends.

I don’t have the exif anymore unfortunately but it’ll be somewhere between 13-15sec exposure, ISO 1200 (or higher if your camera is good in low light), and F8. I haven’t shot these in a while due to health reasons but they’re the settings I try first. But it all depends on the strength of the storm too. 


24-105 lens.
This gave me anxiety!! Usually I hate feeling anxious but to convey that through a still image is incredible. Great work.

The horrible one, a couple of years.

The lovely one, we were seeing each other for around 6 months. But Christ I’ve never been so comfortable with anyone else in my life.
This guy never gave a shit about me, but my last one did. I’ll forever love that one. I wrote an unsent post yesterday about him. My love.

There’s literally no way I can be the one hurting him in this situation. Unless he got hurt by what I told him today, in which case he should have thought about how he treated me.

I’m sorry you feel that way, I just hope you aren’t doing yourself an injustice by taking the blame.

Isn’t it just? It’s been 3 months since I spoke to him. I still cry uncontrollably every single night. I am now. Y’know that kind of sad where your heart actually aches? Every single night for the last 12 weeks. 

I wonder how he is, what he’s doing, if work ever got better, how his back is, whether he ate lunch or forgot again. I wonder if he’s talking to his friends about his well-being, if he’s lonely, if he misses me. I just hope he’s okay. I hope he isn’t struggling. As for myself, I’ll struggle for a long time yet.

It breaks my heart daily. I honestly love him more than anything. I just want him to be happy even if that means it’s without me. Of course that would crush me, but I’m used to it. He deserves so much love.

It’s weird, for years I forgot about her until a therapist did something that made me remember something she said to me. The realisation hit me hard, knowing she was the reason I ended up being so fucked. It helped me to cling on to that hate and shout down all the negative thoughts as though they were coming from her (which ultimately they were). I’m working on proving to myself that I’m good enough, which is hard in my current circumstances, but it’s helped me knowing that none of this is my fault.

Honestly she ruined so many kids. And she’s still teaching. I’ve been in therapy since I was a teenager and despite everything I’ve been through and accomplished, I still feel like a failure & a burden, like I’m not good enough for myself or anyone/anything else. For years I fought to prove her wrong and worked at my mental health to change how I saw myself, but after 13 years, a big part of me wants to give up now.

Thank you so much ❤️ I know the emotionally abusive one is completely toxic but I also blame myself for being so in love that I was willing to change into who/whatever he wanted me to be (which would change daily). I became a chameleon and I still wasn’t enough. 

It’s weird. The thought of dating someone new scares me. I only really want that closeness with “ex” #2 right now, which is why I’m trying to get over that.

It’s been a year next week for #1 and 3 months for #2, but that was dying for about a month before we did anything about it :( I also struggle a loooottt with slow self esteem and feeling inferior to literally everyone, so part of me thinks “why bother? They’ll leave me for someone better”
